Refactored the matcher around a single internal scan engine in [KmpPattern.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/021_kmp_pattern_searching/KmpPattern.java:10). Instead of forcing every operation to build a full match list, the compiled pattern now exposes `findFirstIn`, `countMatchesIn`, `forEachMatchIn`, and early-exit `occursIn` on top of shared traversal logic. I also broadened the API from `String` to `CharSequence`, which makes the code more reusable without changing the core algorithm, and `findMatchesIn` now returns an immutable list.

The facade in [KmpSearch.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/021_kmp_pattern_searching/KmpSearch.java:5) was expanded to mirror those operations cleanly, [KmpSearchDemo.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/021_kmp_pattern_searching/KmpSearchDemo.java:3) now demonstrates the richer API, and [KmpSearchSelfTest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/021_kmp_pattern_searching/KmpSearchSelfTest.java:4) was extended to cover first-match, counting, callback-based enumeration, `CharSequence` inputs, and immutability.
